publisher_access_condition: ไม่มีการจำกัดการเข้าถึงข้อมูล
evidence_method: Official guidance read through web tool; original publisher metadata retained in local raw snapshot
finding: Official GD Catalog guidance describes G0 Open Data Common as permitting reuse, copying, distribution and adaptation. The label and access-condition fields support project reuse; the isopen flag remains a metadata inconsistency to document, not proof by itself that use is prohibited.
project_decision: Continue local research and database development with explicit DMF attribution. Retain raw downloads locally while preparing a clear third-party data notice before any public data release.
scope_limit: This review concerns these public CSV packages only, not lecture PDFs, all DMF website content or competition LCI eligibility. No external publication performed.
